info.title: CSG Learning API — migrated transport contracts

get.summary: Read a lesson for the block editor (admins)

put.summary: Save every block of a lesson in one transaction (admins)
put.description: Atomic: lesson settings, blocks in order, removals and objective alignments commit together. Block ids are kept on reorder. 409 with code stale_editor when base_updated_at is not the current version; 422 with code learner_data, confirm_watch_reset or blocks_mismatch when a save would lose learner work or doesn't list every block, or retry when it collided with learner writes and saved nothing.
